**The audit stops reading an issue number as a PR number (#1086)**

**What**: prView gains an additive `absent` (true only on a definitive not-found, decided by isNotFound in vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs); a new port verb commitPrs({project, sha}) lists the PRs containing a commit; fetchPrMeta dispatches — exactly one PR resolves it, none audits the commit body, two or more stay uncomputable, and any transport failure never reaches the lookup.
**Why**: four merges carry (#978) in their subject and 978 is an issue, not a PR, so prView's single null shape read as an outage and the audit failed closed forever. That blocked the v1.6.0 tag, because release.yml tags only after the audit exits 0.
**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs, vcs/providers/{github,gitlab}.mjs, vcs/cli.mjs, lib/merge-walk.mjs, brain-audit.mjs, brain-metrics.mjs, vcs/fixtures.
**Learned**: the live not-a-PR text is 'GraphQL: Could not resolve to a PullRequest with the number of N'. Two pre-existing 'generic failure' fixtures used a 404 and the words 'not found', so they were simulating an outage with the shape of an absent resource; both were corrected. GitLab's commitPrs refuses a full page instead of deciding on a truncated list. sdd-verify-validate refuses a passing verdict when the recorded test exit code is non-zero, so a change gated on a maintainer promotion must be verified after the promotion, not before.
